He made the remarks during a meeting in Tehran with First Deputy of the Judiciary Hojjatoleslam Hamzeh Khalili where they reviewed common challenges and explored ways for strengthening inter-branch cooperation to address public problems.

Aref emphasized the need for continued coordination among senior officials, saying exchanges of views and joint consultations could help improve responses to public demands.
